summary: The Gaussian law is defined conditionally and its zero endpoint is proved uniform by successive reflections. A worked k=3 calculation makes the derivative transport and vanished repeated derivatives explicit. The tree-growth proof constructs centered revealed-coordinate martingales, stops predictably at coefficient failure and obtains the needed raw-derivative sum. Moment estimates and amplified acceptance inequalities handle promise leakage. Numerical assembly yields a uniform bound and the fixed-k threshold, after which the three-property ingredient is restated. I can follow the algebraic route, but a large analytic chapter now separates the opening construction idea from the still-unseen total board.
